_comment: Merge into .claude/settings.json (project) or ~/.claude/settings.json. Replace NAV_KIT with the nav-kit path, e.g. C:/MyData/nav-kit or /home/me/nav-kit. SessionStart output is injected into the agent's context; it fires on startup, resume, clear, and after compaction. PreCompact and SessionEnd run the deterministic close-out (check, build, commit nav/). Check the current hook reference at https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks before relying on event names.
